searchText: Does anyone know where I can find some SSZ encoded mainnet blocks for test purposes? If you only want to test the format, you could use https://simpleserialize.com/ which supports up to capella You can use https://github.com/wealdtech/ethdo to fetch them, e.g. `ethdo block info --ssz` Exactly what I needed, thanks!
